ns2:course.label: MFA Prof Practice Seminar
ns2:course.description: A course examining current field practices and trends including curatorial practices, and interdisciplinary practices. Includes preparation of practical materials for career presentation and examination of resources. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 3 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in dance.
